items.text: Skill-led routes come first because you can sell the work and set the price.
Maths graduates have eight real routes.
The routes are ordered by how far income and reach can grow, not by prestige or exam difficulty.
Rank-based and exam-led routes come last because pay is fixed and few people reach the top.
Maths is the hard part of this field: linear algebra, probability and optimisation.
